description: Zero-trust SSH certificate authority and control plane. Issues short-lived OpenSSH user certificates to authenticated, explicitly authorized engineers instead of distributing long-lived SSH keys, with every issuance and denial recorded in a tamper-evident audit log.
highlights: Pluggable identity providers — GitHub and Keycloak/OIDC behind one provider abstraction, selectable per request
Deny-by-default authorization via provider-neutral allowlists (GitHub user/org/team, OIDC group/role/attribute)
Manages 1-64 Ed25519 certificate authorities with encrypted keys at rest, administered entirely through an admin API and CLI
Short-lived certificates (default 5 minute TTL, 1 hour max) with a SHA-256 hash-chained, fail-closed audit log
